types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings and roles. PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: The program's upgrade authority at `initialize`. Cannot be changed.

fields.name: relayer
docs: Fills and cancels orders, creates markets.

fields.name: settler
docs: Settles markets.

fields.name: registrar
docs: Registers traders after login.

fields.name: stable_mint
docs: Cannot be changed after `initialize`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Stable token account that receives `cost + fee` on buys and revoked settlement
funds.

fields.name: min_order_units
docs: Applies to buys.

fields.name: max_order_units
docs: Applies to buys and sells.

fields.name: settle_delay_secs
docs: Redemption opens this long after `settle_market`.

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: Bits `PAUSE_PLACE` and `PAUSE_FILL`.

types.name: ConfigChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_config` and `set_pause`; the new values are read from the Config account.

types.name: Market
docs: One venue instrument. PDA `["market", symbol_hash]`.
The market account is the mint authority of both outcome mints, the authority over
their metadata, and the authority of the redemption vault.

fields.name: symbol_hash
docs: sha256 of the `symbol` bytes.

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until created.

fields.name: no_mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until created.

fields.name: status
docs: A `MarketStatus`.

fields.name: close_ts
docs: Venue expiry. Advisory: the relayer may update it.

fields.name: place_cutoff_secs
docs: No new orders within this many seconds of `close_ts`.

fields.name: tick_px
docs: Order prices must be multiples of this.

fields.name: max_supply_units
docs: Supply cap of each outcome mint.

fields.name: yes_payout
docs: Micro-dollars per unit, set at settlement.

fields.name: no_payout
docs: Micro-dollars per unit, set at settlement.

fields.name: redeem_after
docs: Redemption opens at this time. Zero until settled.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Lifecycle of a market. Accounts and events store it as its number.

types.name: Order
docs: One escrowed order. PDA `["order", user, nonce]`, and the authority of its escrow token
account. Closed by the instruction that fills or cancels it.

fields.name: side
docs: A `Side`.

fields.name: kind
docs: An `OrderKind`.

fields.name: limit_px
docs: Highest price of a buy, lowest price of a sell.

fields.name: max_fee
docs: Micro-dollars.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives the rent of the order and its escrow when they close.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The trader's `next_nonce` at placement.

fields.name: by
docs: The signer that cancelled the order.

fields.name: amount
docs: Cost of a buy, proceeds of a sell.

types.name: SetConfigArgs
docs: Every field is optional: `None` keeps the current value.

types.name: Side
docs: Outcome of a market. Accounts and events store it as its number.

types.name: Trader
docs: A wallet that may place orders. PDA `["trader", user]`, created by the registrar.

fields.name: next_nonce
docs: Nonce of the user's next order. It only increases, so order addresses never repeat.

constants.name: CUTOFF_MIN_SECS
docs: Shortest allowed gap between the last order placement and a market's close time.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_PER_UNIT
docs: An order's fee cap may not exceed `qty_units * MAX_FEE_PER_UNIT + MAX_FEE_BASE`.

constants.name: OUTCOME_DECIMALS
docs: Outcome tokens have two decimals: one unit is 0.01 contract.

constants.name: PAUSE_FILL
docs: Pause bit: no fills.

constants.name: PAUSE_PLACE
docs: Pause bit: no new orders.

constants.name: PAYOUT_TOTAL
docs: `yes_payout + no_payout` of a settled market, in micro-dollars per unit.

constants.name: PX_MAX
docs: Prices are micro-dollars per unit, from 1 to this value.

constants.name: STABLE_DECIMALS
docs: The stablecoin is a classic SPL Token mint with six decimals: one base unit is one
micro-dollar.
